# JustPlay Engineering Defaults

Keep this file short. Docs are the source of truth; this file defines always-on non-negotiables.

## Non-Negotiable Rules
- Start from a requirement/use-case and design note before implementation.
- Do not develop directly on main; use feature branches and pull requests.
- Keep changes small, testable, and aligned with iterative delivery.
- New behavior requires unit tests; behavior changes require test updates.
- Prefer simple, maintainable modules and explicit side effects.
- Use trusted dependency sources and stable releases only.
